keyboardHelp: Yi amfani da W/A/S/D don motsawa da maɓallan kibiya don nufa. Q don tsalle, E don sunkuya, J don miƙa ƙwallo; riƙe K don tara ƙarfi ka saki don harbawa. Tab yana canja ɗan wasa.
touchHelp: Motsa da faifan taɓawa na hagu, ka nufa da faifan dama. Yi amfani da maɓallan tsalle, sunkuya, miƙa da harba.
chargeHelp: Riƙe maɓallin harba don tara ƙarfi, sannan ka saki a daidai lokacin. Idan kana kusa da kwando, gwada layup ko dunk.
deviceNote: Wasu masu bincike ba sa bayyana cikakken bayanin ƙwaƙwalwa ko CPU. Gajeren gwaji yana ƙiyasta ingancin da ya dace; za ka iya canja shi da hannu.
replayHint: Ja hagu ko dama don juya kyamara ka kalli muhimmin lokacin a 360° a sannu-sannu.
mapPrivacy: Ana tambayar wurinka ne kawai idan ka taɓa maɓallin wuri. Buɗe taswira yana aika lambobin wurin zuwa Google Maps.
mapReady: An samu wuri. Buɗe Google Maps don neman filayen ƙwallon kwando na kusa.
mapDenied: An ƙi izinin wuri. Har yanzu za ka iya neman yankinka a Google Maps.
mapUnavailable: Babu wuri. Duba goyon bayan mai bincike, yi amfani da HTTPS kuma ka ba da izinin samun wuri.

rule_batting: Motsa W/A/S/D · Kugu Z/C · Nufa ←↑↓→ · Kaɗa sanda K. Lokacin bugawa + Kugu → Nisa.

rule_basketball: Riƙe maɓallin harba don tara ƙarfi, sannan ka saki a daidai lokacin. Idan kana kusa da kwando, gwada layup ko dunk. Wannan yanayin nishaɗi yana ba kowane kwando maki 2 ko 3; ba ya bin ƙa'idojin FIBA 3×3 na hukuma.
rule_soccer5: Motsa, nufa, miƙa ƙwallo ka saki harbi mai ƙarfi zuwa ragar abokin hamayya. Lissafin maki na horo mai sauƙi.
rule_baseball: Mai jefawa yana jefa ƙwallo mai sauri, mai lanƙwasa, mai zamewa da mai rage gudu a ciki ko kusa da yankin bugawa. Matsar da wurin haɗuwar sanda zuwa ƙwallon, riƙe K don shiryawa ka saki lokacin da ƙwallo ta wuce faranti. Da wuri tana karkata gefen da ka ja, a makare tana zuwa ɗaya gefen. Bugu: 1 tushe ɗaya, 2 tushe biyu, 3 tushe uku, 4 gudun gida (home run); fita uku suna ƙare zagaye.

keyboardBatting: W/A/S/D: matsar da wurin haɗuwar sanda cikin yankin (ko taɓa yankin) · Maɓallan kibiya: kusurwar tashi da ja/tura · Riƙe K ka saki don kaɗawa · Riƙe Q ka saki don kaɗawa mai ƙarfi · Riƙe E ka saki don kaɗawa don haɗuwa · J: bugu mai laushi
touchBatting: Faifan hagu ko taɓa yankin: wurin haɗuwar sanda · Faifan dama: kusurwar tashi · Kaɗawa, ƙarfi da haɗuwa maɓallai uku ne daban: danna, sannan ka saki idan ƙwallo ta isa faranti · J: bugu mai laushi
keyboardGeneric: W/A/S/D: motsa · Maɓallan kibiya: nufa · Riƙe K don tara ƙarfi, saki don aiki · J: aiki na biyu · Q/E: tsalle / sunkuya · Tab: canja ɗan wasa
keyboardTarget: Maɓallan kibiya: nufa · Riƙe K don tara ƙarfi, saki don harba · J: sake saita nufa
touchGeneric: Faifan hagu yana motsawa, faifan dama yana nufa; riƙe babban maɓalli ka saki. Maɓallai suna ƙarƙashin yanayin wasa kai tsaye.
controlsHere: Maɓallan hannu biyu suna ƙarƙashin yanayin wasa kai tsaye.
rule_basketball5: Horon 5 da 5 a cikakken fili. Kai hari ga kwandon nesa: maki 2 a cikin baka, 3 a waje; masu tsaro suna kai hari ta ɗaya gefen. Riƙe K don tara ƙarfin harbi ka saki kusa da alama; J don miƙa; Q don tsalle; Tab don canja ɗan wasa.
rule_field-hockey: Horon hoki na 'yan wasa 5 a kowane gefe. Riƙe ƙwallo a sandarka, miƙa da J ka harba ƙasa-ƙasa da K daga cikin da'irar harbi. Abokan hamayya za su iya ƙwace idan sun kusanto.
rule_water-polo: Horon wurin iyo na 'yan wasa 4 a kowane gefe. 'Yan wasa suna iyo a hankali, don haka ka miƙa da wuri (J) ka jefa zuwa ƙaramar raga da K. Riƙe sunkuya don matsa wa mai riƙe da ƙwallo.
rule_softball: Jifa ta ƙasan hannu daga da'ira mafi kusa da ƙwallo mafi girma. Matsar da wurin haɗuwar sanda zuwa ƙwallon, riƙe K ka saki idan ƙwallo ta isa faranti. Bugu suna ba da maki 1–4 na horo.
rule_beach-volleyball: 2 da 2 a kan yashi. Shiga ƙarƙashin ƙwallo, saki K don kai hari sama da raga ko J don ɗaga ƙwallo a hankali. Ana samun maki idan ƙwallo ta taɓa yashin ɗaya gefen.
rule_golf: Nufa da faifan dama, riƙe K don saita ƙarfi, saki don kaɗawa. Ƙarancin bugu zuwa rami yana ba da ƙarin maki; rami da bugu ɗaya maki 10 ne. Ana nuna iska a kan allo.
rule_cricket: Ƙwallon mai jefawa (bowler) tana tashi sau ɗaya daga ƙasa kafin ta iso gare ka. Matsar da sanda zuwa layin ƙwallo, riƙe K ka saki a layin bugawa (crease). Ana samun maki gwargwadon nisa, 4 idan ta kai iyaka, 6 idan ta wuce igiya; idan ka rasa ƙwallo ta buga turakun (stumps), an fitar da kai (bowled).
rule_sepak-takraw: Ƙwallon raga ta ƙafa ta 3 da 3. Tsaya ƙarƙashin ƙwallo ka saki K don shura ta sama da raga, ko J don ɗagawa cikin kulawa. Kada ƙwallo ta taɓa ƙasa a gefenka.
rule_squash: Buga ƙwallo a bangon gaba sama da ƙarfen ƙasa (tin). Mayar da ita kafin tsalle na biyu; abokin hamayya ma dole ya yi haka. Kowace musayar bugu tana ƙarewa da maki.
rule_lacrosse: Horon sanda na 'yan wasa 5 a kowane gefe. Riƙe ƙwallo a cikin ragar sandarka, miƙa da J ka harba da K zuwa ƙaramar raga. Masu tsaro za su iya bugun sandar mai riƙe da ƙwallo.
rule_bowling: Nufa da faifan dama, riƙe K don saita gudu ka saki. Turakun da suka faɗi suna ba da maki; faɗuwar duka goma a bugu ɗaya ita ce strike. Juyawa da faifan hagu.
rule_soft-tennis: 2 da 2 da ƙwallon roba mai laushi da ke tsalle sama a hankali. Saki K don bugu kai tsaye, J don ɗagawa. Tsalle ɗaya kafin kowace mayarwa.
rule_billiards: Nufa da faifan dama, riƙe K don ƙarfi ka saki don buga farar ƙwallo. Saka sauran ƙwallaye a aljihu don samun maki; saka farar ƙwallo a aljihu kuskure ne (scratch).
rule_flag-football: Ƙwallon ƙafa ta 'yan wasa 5 a kowane gefe ba tare da karo ba. Gudu ko miƙa (J) zuwa yankin ƙarshe; idan mai tsaro ya cire tutarka wasan ya tsaya. Maki 6 na horo a kowane touchdown.
